title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 26: Uzziah's strength and success, his pride, and the leprosy that struck him.

questions.text: How long did Uzziah reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: In whose days did Uzziah set himself to seek God?
questions.explanation: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God.

questions.text: The walls of which cities did Uzziah break down when he fought against the Philistines?
questions.explanation: He broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod.
2 Chronicles 26:8 says the Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah.

questions.text: Why did Uzziah have farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and fruitful fields?
questions.explanation: He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

answers.text: The priests needed wine for offerings

questions.text: What were the devices Uzziah made in Jerusalem used for?
questions.explanation: He made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones.

answers.text: To draw water from the cisterns
To shoot arrows and great stones

questions.text: Why did Uzziah go into Yahweh's temple when his heart was lifted up?
questions.explanation: When he was strong his heart was lifted up, and he went into Yahweh's temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

answers.text: To pray for victory over the Philistines
To take the gold vessels for himself
To anoint his son Jotham as king
To burn incense on the altar of incense

questions.text: Which priest went in after Uzziah with eighty priests of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of Yahweh, who were valiant men.

questions.text: Where did the leprosy break out on Uzziah?
questions.explanation: While he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests, beside the altar of incense.

questions.text: Who wrote the rest of the acts of Uzziah?
questions.explanation: The rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

answers.text: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer
Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz
